picks.why: ASML has +55% revenue growth, a +44% operating margin and a 24.8x forward P/E, and trades 22% below its high after the segment fell 23% in a month. It is the quality way into the compute build-out (ai-demand-exceeds-supply) rather than a cash-burning developer.
picks.risk: A hyperscaler capex cut or another -7% semis day would hit the multiple regardless of its margins.

picks.why: Credo has +115% revenue growth, a +25% operating margin and a 15.5x forward P/E, with the stock 51% off its high. The price already assumes the AI network build slows, which limits the downside if compute demand outruns supply.
picks.risk: FCF yield is only 1% and the stock is 17% under its 200-day average, so the downtrend could continue if the semis selloff spreads.
